rav-mari-brei-derav-kahana.name: Rav Mari, son of Rav Kahana
rav-mari-brei-derav-kahana.bio: Babylonian Amora, son of Rav Kahana.
rav-mari-brei-derav-kahana.prompt: A practical Babylonian scholar in his 40s with a dark, neatly kept beard and an observant, matter-of-fact expression, as if reporting a careful household ruling; background of mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps.

roman-emperor.name: The Emperor
roman-emperor.bio: The Roman emperor who, in the Talmud’s stories, puts questions to Rabbi Yehoshua ben Ḥananya.
roman-emperor.prompt: A Roman emperor in his 40s with a short curled beard and a laurel wreath, wearing a white toga with a broad purple border, with a curious, testing expression; background of marble columns in a palace hall. Roman dress rather than a tallit or head covering.

elders-of-athens.name: The Elders of Athens
elders-of-athens.bio: The sages of the school of Athens whom, the Talmud relates, Rabbi Yehoshua ben Ḥananya bested in a contest of riddles.
elders-of-athens.prompt: A proud Greek philosopher in his 60s with a long white beard and a haughty, challenging look, wearing a draped himation, standing for the elders of an Athenian school; background of a stone stoa with columns. Greek dress rather than a tallit or head covering.

butcher-of-athens.name: The Butcher
butcher-of-athens.bio: A butcher in Athens who, the Talmud relates, showed Rabbi Yehoshua ben Ḥananya the way to the school of the elders.
butcher-of-athens.prompt: A burly, wary tradesman in his 40s with a short beard and rolled sleeves, a leather apron over a plain tunic, glancing over his shoulder nervously; background of a market stall in an ancient Greek city. Simple Greek work clothes rather than a tallit or head covering.
